items.source: Get the members within the circle defined by the members coordinates and given radius applying Metric and RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.
items.translation: 获取圆内的成员，该圆由成员的坐标和给定半径定义，应用Metric和RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs。

items.source: Sets the RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.Flag.WITHCOORD flag to also return the longitude, latitude coordinates of the matching items.
items.translation: 将RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.Flag.WITHCOORD标志设置为同时返回匹配项的经度和纬度坐标。

items.source: Sets the RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.Flag.WITHDIST flag to also return the distance of the returned items from the specified center.
items.translation: 将 RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.Flag.WITHDIST 标志设置为 true，以返回指定中心点与返回项之间的距离。

items.source: Get the members within the boundaries of a given Circle applying given parameters.
items.translation: 获取给定Circle边界内的成员，并应用给定的参数。

items.source: Get the members within given Distance from member applying given parameters.
items.translation: 根据给定参数，从应用该参数的成员中获取指定范围内的 Distance 内的成员。

items.source: Core package for integrating Redis with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 用于将 Redis 与 Spring 概念集成的核心包。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Limit the results to the first N matching items.
items.translation: 将结果限制为前 N 个匹配项。

items.source: Apply a sort direction.
items.translation: 应用排序方向。

items.source: Sort returned items from the nearest to the furthest, relative to the center.
items.translation: 根据距离中心的远近，对返回的商品进行排序。

items.source: Sort returned items from the furthest to the nearest, relative to the center.
items.translation: 根据与中心的距离，将退回的商品从最远到最近排序。
